paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Comparison of different query selection strategies. During training, we first expand the document with a query selected from the generated queries using a specific strategy, and then train DPR with the expanded document. During inference, we evaluate the well-trained DPR retrievers with corpus expansion (solid lines) and the typical representation (dotted lines) on the dev set of MS-Marco, where the solid and dotted lines with the same color are results for the same DPR.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates a comparison of different query selection strategies, showing the MRR@10 metric as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)," using a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and employs a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A black solid line, labeled "DPR w/o query," starts at 34.9 at x=1 and increases to 35.2 at x=10. A purple dashed line, labeled "DPR w/o query," starts at 34.7 at x=1 and decreases to 34.6 at x=10. A green solid line, labeled "DPR w/ gold," begins at 33.2 at x=1 and increases to 35.6 at x=10. A magenta dashed line, labeled "DPR w/ gold," starts at 34.1 at x=1 and decreases to 34.2 at x=10. A red solid line, labeled "DPR w/ top-1," starts at 35.2 at x=1 and declines to 33.2 at x=10. A brown dashed line, labeled "DPR w/ top-1," begins at 35.4 at x=1 and decreases to 35.2 at x=10. An orange solid line, labeled "DPR w/ random," starts at 34.7 at x=1 and increases to 35.7 at x=10. A red dashed line, labeled “DPR w/ curriculum,” begins at 35.1 at x=1 and decreases to 35.4 at x=10.
